description: RFC 8621 §4.5 defines collapseThreads as an argument to Email/queryChanges (the same argument used with the Email/query that produced the query state). The handler never reads it and never forwards it to the backend. For a backend that distinguishes collapsed vs non-collapsed query states this means the backend cannot return the correct delta. For a client that used collapseThreads=true in the original query, the queryChanges response may include per-email deltas that should have been collapsed to per-thread deltas. Fix: parse collapseThreads from args and pass it through to the backend's query_changes call (requires adding it to the QueryChangesResult or as a separate backend parameter).
title: Email/queryChanges drops collapseThreads argument
